title: Gulf Walk
meta_description: Renovated 1BR condo in Laguna Beach with additional bunk beds, 2 patios, pool access \& steps to Beach Access #72---perfect blend of comfort \& convenience.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Gulf Walk, your refined retreat in the serene Laguna Beach community --- just minutes from Pier Park and steps from Beach Access #72. This recently renovated 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo with hallway bunks and a sleeper sofa offers a thoughtful balance of style, comfort, and coastal simplicity, ideal for families and small groups alike.

Inside, discover a modern, open-concept living area with luxury vinyl plank flooring, stainless-steel appliances, and a fully stocked kitchen that makes dining in effortless. Bright coastal décor and soft natural tones create a relaxed atmosphere perfect for unwinding after a day on the sand.

Enjoy two private patios, ideal for your morning coffee or a quiet evening under the stars. The property's prime location ensures you're just steps away from the community pool and brand-new onsite amenities, including pickleball courts, shaded pavilions, charcoal grills, and a mini putt-putt pad --- perfect for casual fun and family connection.

Experience the best of Panama City Beach's West End, where tranquility meets convenience:
- Pier Park (only minutes away) -- premier shopping, dining, and family entertainment.
- McGuire's Irish Pub -- hearty Irish fare and a lively local atmosphere.
- Camp Helen State Park -- explore coastal dunes, trails, and Lake Powell.
- Conservation Park -- scenic boardwalks and birdwatching trails.
- Man in the Sea Museum -- dive into PCB's maritime history.
- Carousel Supermarket \& Thomas Donut \& Snack Shop -- classic local favorites.
- 30Avenue \& Inlet Beach (7 miles) \| ECP Airport (14 miles)
- Top Golf, Pirates Voyage Dinner \& Show

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!
Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- Parking is available for a mandatory $25 fee.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
